APPROVE

`InScript` now only holds two flat `if` blocks and each helper stays well under 15, with the same loops and conditions in the same order; I couldn't find the source file to check that the guessed parameter types (`Func<Family, bool>`, `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, bool>`, `IReadOnlySet<string>`) match what `GuardBindings`, `Known` and `InStyleSheet` use, so the build condition rests on a compile check.
